subject: design/local-work-tracker-v2
statement: the **ready-set** and **triage-set** predicates are one Go function each, in the core, consumed identically by the engine (through the port) and the CLI (DINV-6 — AP-11/INV-30). The tracker-side ready predicate is `open ∧ carries an authorization-role signal ∧ has no open blocker ∧ is not a structural rollup (epic/plan) ∧ has no closing decision-record`; the triage predicate is `open ∧ has no triage-disposition record ∧ is not a structural rollup ∧ has no open blocker ∧ is not assignee-held`. Results are stably sorted by creation order for fair rotation (INV-12). **Boundary:** full pipeline readiness also depends on *no active lease* and *no open proposal* — those live behind the LeaseStore and ProposalService ports; the tracker exposes its half and the engine composes the rest (§3.2).
